description: Search the items Atlantic Agentic Labs has published about how it works: how engagements run, its technology partners, its positioning and its use cases. Use it for questions about Atlantic as a company rather than the product's mechanics. Returns passages quoted exactly, each with a link to the published item, its revision and publication date; `covered` is false when nothing published answers the query. It gives no prices or commercial terms: such a query returns a fixed note and no passages. Examples: "how does an engagement start", "which clouds does Atlantic deploy to".

limit.description: How many passages to return (1 to 8).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: What to look for, in plain words or the exact terms the documentation would use. One topic per call. Examples: "how are approvals enforced", "connect Amazon S3", "POST /api/v1/keys", "hosted MCP OAuth scopes".
query.title: Query
